This is a straightforward observation/navigation task where the agent must locate pink stained glass placed in the scene. It is clearly observable and verifiable — the agent needs to have pink_stained_glass visible in its field of view or approach it closely. Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, there are no dependencies, but the task itself is well-suited for benchmarking because: (1) pink stained glass has a distinctive color making it visually identifiable, (2) it requires the agent to explore and navigate the environment, (3) it is easily verifiable through proximity or visual confirmation, and (4) it doesn't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just finding an object in the world.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the pink stained glass block (within 5 blocks) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is the eye-level pink stained glass at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7), which is the nearest and most visible of the three pink stained glass blocks in the stone brick building. A 5-block max_distance requires active navigation from spawn (~8.6 blocks away) while being generous enough to not require pixel-perfect positioning. 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the target.

scene_description: A compact scene with a stone brick building containing pink stained glass blocks. The building is located ~6 blocks to the southeast of spawn. Pink stained glass is embedded in the walls at various heights (eye-level and above). A secondary oak plank structure sits to the northwest as a distractor, and a lantern on cobblestone provides a landmark to the north. The agent must navigate toward the stone brick building to find the pink stained glass.
task_text: Find pink stained glass in the nearby environment. Explore the area and locate the pink stained glass blocks.
design_notes: Pink stained glass is placed at 3 locations in the stone brick building: (1) ~7 ~2 ~8 - upper back wall, (2) ~6 ~2 ~8 - upper back wall adjacent, (3) ~5 ~1 ~7 - eye-level side wall facing spawn. The eye-level block is visible from spawn direction. The building has a doorway at ~5 ~1-2 ~6 for entry. Oak plank structure to the northwest serves as visual distractor. Lantern on cobblestone to the north serves as a landmark.
